body: REDGARDEN commit 903757c. Flamel ties the roster to the cooking system directly for the first time. Druid is a moving nature archetype distinct from The Tree. Setting note: RED GARDEN develops on its own simpler premise, not forced into TrapX's city-dweller frame despite heavy conceptual overlap; Highlands nature setting reads better for the LoL crowd. Flagged: Morrigan/Druid ally+counter-play relationship, not built yet.
title: Flamel (master cook) + Druid (tree-growy) added to roster; Highlands setting note
